zh.title: Skill Python 运行时与环境修复
highlights: Skill Python 运行时完整闭环（issue #523）：技能声明 runtime.yaml 后，经审批在隔离 venv 安装依赖并参数化执行脚本，CLI 与桌面端共用同一套内核能力。
修复桌面自定义存储路径下 CLI 数据根漂移（#525）；GitHub 镜像改用 git 原生 insteadOf，不再污染仓库配置（#524）。
桌面工具命令区降噪（进行中的工作组默认折叠）；新增对话式技能创建与草稿审阅发布。
zh.notice: 曾配置 kkgithub/fastgit 镜像的用户将解析为直连，建议改用 ghproxy 或 gitcode。

en.title: Skill Python runtime and environment fixes
highlights: Full Skill Python runtime loop (issue #523): skills declaring runtime.yaml get approved dependency installs into isolated venvs and parameterized script execution; CLI and desktop share one kernel.
Fixes the CLI data root drifting from the desktop's custom storage location (#525); GitHub mirroring now uses git's native insteadOf and no longer pollutes repo config (#524).
Desktop tool-call noise reduction with collapsed live work groups, plus conversational skill creation with draft review and publication.
en.notice: kkgithub/fastgit mirror configurations now resolve to direct connections; switch to ghproxy or gitcode if needed.
